page.overview:
Who is Borso?

Prince Borso of Pavona, husband of Lucrezzia Belladonna and mercenary general. After his defeat at the Battle of Etobrutti, in 2494 IC, his wounds were mistakenly treated with poisonous herbs, which resulted in his death. Mercenary captain Donato took over the command of the troops in his place, defeated Verezzo's army , saved the city and subsequently married Lucrezzia.
